answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 33583 Country: India Title: If someone says Talbiyah during Tawaf (May it be Tawaf of Umrah or Hajj) due to ignorance or forgetfully, then is there any affect on validity of Tawaf, Umrah or Hajj? Question: If someone says Talbiyah during Tawaf (May it be Tawaf of Umrah or Hajj) due to ignorance or forgetfully, then is there any affect on validity of Tawaf, Umrah or Hajj? Answer ID: 33583 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1273/1273/M=1432) It shall not have any effect on the validity of tawaf though it is the tawaf of hajj or umrah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
